rationale: This record is an annual archival guide supplement describing recently acquired collections and accruals at the International Institute of Social History (IISH). It does not address water or sanitation service access (c1), any legal or administrative mechanism governing service access (c2), empirical research or systematic synthesis (c3), or service access outcomes (c4). Excluded under E01 (wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: No difference between narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings; the record is an archival holdings supplement completely unrelated to household or community water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Guide to the International Archives and Collections at the IISH: Supplement over 2006
